query:
with old as (
            select id, budget_ai_enabled as enabled
            from users where id = $1
            for update
        )
        update users u
           set prefs = $2, currency = $3, time_zone = $4,
               budget_ai_enabled = $5, budget_ai_threshold = $6
          from old
         where u.id = old.id
        returning old.enabled
